notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard RTIambassador services after a federate has resigned while its connection remains open. The adapter supplies the provider package, baseline FOM, endpoint, logical-time selection, and callback configuration. The scenario obtains valid handles and object identity while joined, then asserts FederateNotExecutionMember across standard lookup, declaration, object-management, interaction, time-management, synchronization, and save-request services. It does not assert provider diagnostics, registries, private headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador service calls with FederateNotExecutionMember outcomes after resignation
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador service declarations and exception specifications
